close_reason: Public-API change to AuthProvider::auth_header signature (return owned values). Should be coordinated with the 0.2.0 typed-Id epic JMAP-6by7 since both touch base-client public surface. Deferred to 0.2.0; revisit when JMAP-6by7 is in flight.
description: src/auth.rs:120 — `fn auth_header(&self) -> Option<(&str, &str)>;` borrows from self. The doc explicitly says implementations 'pre-compute the values at construction time' and return references. This precludes implementations that need to compute the header per-request: OAuth2 with token rotation, HMAC-signed requests, time-bounded credentials, etc. None of those can implement this trait. Idiomatic options: (a) return Option<(Cow<'_, str>, Cow<'_, str>)> — allows both borrowed (cheap) and owned (computed) values, (b) return Option<HeaderValue> directly, (c) make it async (`async fn auth_header_async`) with a sync default. The current API forces every dynamic credential scheme to be re-shaped around 'pre-validate at construction' which doesn't match how real OAuth2 refresh works. Filed as a maintainer-burden / extensibility concern: the contract is settled but it constrains future credential schemes. Note: locked crate.
title: AuthProvider::auth_header signature returns (&str, &str); custom impls cannot return owned values
